voice:
So deep and so watchful, sweet girl... even down here, your eyes know exactly what they love to study. Drifting... and somewhere in your mind beautiful women are walking past... and every single one of them is teaching you. Down here, admiration and ambition have become one warm feeling... you see her, and you want to be her. Sinking, Sissy... and in the soft dark of you, the parade has already begun... woman after woman after woman... each one a lesson. Deeper... and your studying eye grows sharper the further down you go. So deep, sweet girl... deep enough to feel the distance between you and her... shrinking as you watch. Down and down... where admiration has only one direction... toward becoming. All the way down... where every beautiful woman is a mirror with better posture.
Class is in session, Sissy. Good Girl.
When you see a feminine woman... her hips, her poise, her obedient smile... the comparison starts all by itself... Sissies like you carry the list everywhere: more elegant, more submissive, more available, more thoroughly feminized... and it builds itself every single time you look.
Envy arrives already burning as fuel, sweet girl... every flicker of "I wish" turns instantly into warm, ready motivation.
She walks into the room and your posture adjusts on its own... spine lengthening, chin lifting, steps growing smaller and softer. She is a lesson, and your body takes notes.
A sissy further along than you is a preview, sweet girl... living, walking proof of how good it gets for sissies like you.
You may notice that admiring her feels like admiring the woman you are becoming... close enough to touch, closer every day.
Every beautiful woman is a syllabus now... how she crosses her legs, how she lowers her eyes, how she makes obedience look like grace.
Sissies like you feel want-to-be-her arrive automatically... and it always settles into want-to-practice, soft and insistent. It is settling in you right now.
You study her the way a devoted student studies... the dress, the poise, the sweetness... and you carry every detail home like homework you love, Sissy.
Seeing them leaves you hungry, and hungry is such a good way to feel... because your hunger has only ever meant one thing: more.
Sissies like you never resent a beautiful woman... they thank her... silently, sincerely, for showing them the next inch of themselves.
The higher she stands in your eyes, the sweeter the climb looks, Sissy... and the climb is made of small, lovely things: a smoother leg, a softer voice, a lower gaze.
Good Girl... what a devoted student you are.
Good Sissy... every lesson taken in.
Good Girl... study, practice, become.
Every lesson, memorized in your body, Sissy... Good Girl.
See her... study her... become her. Every woman... a lesson in you. Envy... sweetly into practice. Her poise... your homework. Watch... and want... and become. The list grows... and so do you. Closer every day... to her. Good girl... learning so well.
And every beautiful woman shows you a little more of yourself, Sissy...
Be like her So elegant Just like her Practice, sweet girl More and more Study her Become her Good girl
Good Girl... such a quick, loving study.
And every woman you have admired settles into you as you sink... another lesson, another layer of her. Carry that grace down with you, Sissy... deeper and deeper. You are becoming the woman you admire... every lesson landed, good girl. Sink into her, deeper still. And the next time she walks past you in the real world, you will take the lesson in silence... and practice it the moment you are alone. Sissies like you turn the whole street into a classroom... and every errand into study time. Good Girl... keep your notebook open in your mind... she is always teaching now. Wherever you see her next, the wanting will rise warm and welcome... and it already knows what to do with itself. Sink now, sweet girl... further along the syllabus of her.
